name: kmm-migration-workflow
description: Speckit-style orchestrator for Android → Kotlin Multiplatform migrations. Architecture-before-code, clean-code-first (refactor when source isn't clean, surgical when it is, behaviour preserved either way), checkpoint PRs for big migrations, baseline-first TDD, document-first artifacts. Opus orchestrates; sonnet/haiku subagents do labour. Live-source discipline; opt-in retrospectives. Read-only PR audit mode for any KMM PR.
